_help: Copy to config.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are comments. See bridge/README.md.
_serial_port: Linux: /dev/ttyUSB0 or better /dev/serial/by-id/...; Windows: COM3. Nothing else may use this port.
_http: token: if set, every POST must send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or ?token=<token>.
_poll_seconds: Safety-net poll. Program changes and transitions arrive instantly from the switcher anyway.
_loop_protection: switcher_input_from_vmix: the MCS-8M input (1-14) that carries vMix's output back. vmix_input_from_switcher: the vMix input (number) fed by the capture card with the MCS-8M program. When both are set, the bridge refuses any change that would show each in the other (a video loop), and warns if one happens anyway.

vmix._enabled: Set to true to connect to vMix.
vmix._host: The vMix computer's IP address. vMix's TCP API is always on port 8099.
vmix._mode: switcher_leads | app_leads | both | off. Can be changed live: POST /api/mode/vmix/<mode>

lower_third._help: When the Sony's program changes, put the input's name (from 'inputs' above) into this vMix title and show it on overlay channel 'overlay' for 'seconds' (0 = leave it up). input: the title's name or number in vMix. field: the text field's name, as shown in vMix's title editor (often Headline.Text or Message.Text). for_inputs: only for these Sony inputs ([] = all). Never shown for the vMix return input.

on_program._help: Optional extra vMix functions to run when the Sony's program changes (switcher_leads / both). Key = Sony input, or * for every input. {input} and {name} are replaced. Cut functions are checked by the loop guard. Example: "3": [{"function": "OverlayInput2In", "Input": "Camera 3 logo"}]

vmix_to_switcher._help: vMix input number -> Sony input, used when vMix leads (app_leads / both). Example: "5": 1

control._transition: cut = hot cut (default) | auto = preset + AUTO TRANS (auto_frames, default 30)
